# Dezeen

> > Dezeen is the world's leading architecture, design, and interiors magazine, delivering breaking news, in-depth studio features, and curated project coverage across the built environment.

Dezeen provides comprehensive coverage of architecture, design, and interiors through daily news updates, weekly digests, award coverage, and exclusive studio features. The publication serves as a primary resource for industry professionals and design enthusiasts seeking the latest trends, notable projects, and influential voices in contemporary design.

## Key Topics

- Architecture News
- Design Magazine
- Interior Design
- Product Design
- Architecture Awards
- Studio Features
- Latest Projects
- Weekly Digest
- OMA
- SANAA
- New Museum
- Design Culture
- Built Environment
- Contemporary Design
- Design Trends
